name: China Everbright Environment Group Limited
summary: China Everbright Environment Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides environmental solutions worldwide. The company's Environmental Energy Project Construction and Operation segment constructs and operates food and kitchen waste treatment, leachate and fecal treatment, sludge treatment and disposal, fly ash landfill, medical waste, and solid waste treatment projects, as well as waste-to-energy and methane-to-energy plants. It also provides integrated urban, waste sorting, technical consultancy and engineering design, renewable resources utilization, and sanitation operation services.
